Lior Beres Hi Ben

 

Tne consulate latest answer...."We are happy to proceed as discussed, please be aware that without Israeli recommendations, there stands the risk of your request being denied". How is this possible? I haven't lived in Israel for 38 years. No family, no friends. I just want to get married and live my last years in Israel. I did my tzahal service. I was a member of a kibbutz. But its all worthless according to the Consulate. Do I now just give up?
